paragraphs.text: The Gilt-Leaf was the strongest elvish tribe on the plane of Lorwyn . The center of their realm was the Gilt-Leaf Wood and its capital Lys Alana , where the king and queen reigned along with their court of Perfect and Exquisite elves .

The Gilt-Leaf tribe was known for their effective, ruthless packs of hunters and for being among the most obsessed with the concept of beauty to determine an individual's status and worth. Those who were found ugly, disfigured, or maimed were proclaimed eyeblights and either killed or transformed into vinebred warriors. Before their power was weakened after the fall of Oona and the New Phyrexian Invasion , they were known as the Gilt-Leaf Empire.
The Gilt-Leaf elves wore green and gold as their main colors.
The tribe's hunter army was divided into packs, each led by an officer of the rank of daen . The highest commanding officer held the rank of taercenn .
